summary.name: Ice
summary.one_liner: Ice is a macOS menu bar manager for hiding, showing, and arranging menu bar items.
use_cases: hide clutter from the macOS menu bar
reveal hidden menu bar icons when needed
search for a menu bar item
adjust spacing between menu bar items
summary.what_it_does: Ice manages the macOS menu bar, with its primary function being hiding and showing menu bar items. Hidden items can be shown below the menu bar. A drag-and-drop interface lets you arrange menu bar items. You can customize the menu bar's appearance, search menu bar items, and set custom spacing between items. The page describes it as aiming to cover a wide range of additional features, but lists only the ones above.
notable: Shows hidden menu bar items in a panel below the menu bar
Drag-and-drop arrangement of menu bar items
caveats: Pricing and licensing are not stated on the page
Feature list is brief; the page does not detail additional capabilities
